correctness.rationale: Constant width gives \(K-K=wB_2\), hence singleton support faces. The support-function identity implies \(\mu+\tau_\pi\mu=w\,d\theta\); positivity makes the curvature measure absolutely continuous with bounded density, so the support-point map is Lipschitz. The unoriented diameter sweep is then a Lipschitz map from a Möbius strip whose boundary winds once around every interior point, hence has relative mod-2 degree one. Rademacher and the area formula discard the nondifferentiable and zero-Jacobian images; each remaining finite fiber has odd size. Bárány--Hug--Schneider give a.e. finiteness under relative general position, which strict convexity supplies for \(K\) and \(-K\).
